# anecdotes_framework_folder (Resource)

Anecdotes Folder Resource - Used to organize frameworks into folders.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Group frameworks under a framework folder.
resource "anecdotes_framework_folder" "security" {
  name = "Security Frameworks"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the folder.

### Read-Only

- `folder_id` (String) The unique identifier for the folder (UUID format).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a framework folder by its folder_id.
terraform import anecdotes_framework_folder.example folder_98765
```
